questions.text: Some valid profiles give a daily calorie target at or below 0 kcal. Example: female, 100 years, 100 cm, 30 kg, lose weight = (264 x 1.4) - 500 = -130 kcal. The database only accepts a target above 0. What should happen when the computed target is 0 kcal or less?
options: Refuse the save with a message (e.g. 'This goal gives a calorie target that is too low; choose maintain or gain weight')
Apply a minimum target instead (give the value or values in the answer, e.g. 1,200 kcal)
Save it unchanged and change the database rule to allow 0 or negative targets
questions.reason: REQ-406 accepts age 13-100, height 100-250 cm and weight 30-300 kg, but its formula (Mifflin-St Jeor x 1.4, -500 for lose) goes below 0 for some of these with goal 'lose weight'. profiles.daily_calorie_target has CHECK (> 0), so the save would currently fail with a server error. The plan cannot pick a behaviour without guessing.
